runtime_patches: Add missing #include <cstdint> in rasterizer_impl.h for CUDA 12 compilation
Remove unused Open3D imports from scene/gaussian_model.py and scene/dataset_readers.py

depth_model.loading: Explicit local source and strict checkpoint loading; no automatic hub downloads

initialization.source: Frozen train-only sparse SfM cloud; no dense MVS initialization

pseudo_camera_bounds: Per-train-view positive Z of projected in-frustum frozen SfM points, percentiles [0.1,99.9]; no occlusion estimate
raster_pixel_origin: Native samples integer indices; shift native projected means by -0.5 pixel on both real and pseudo cameras to match frozen gsplat rays sampled at pixel index +0.5
evaluation: Independent process after successful completion; native FSGS renderer with the existing SSIM/LPIPS-Alex metric definitions
baseline: Preserved uniform L1 A1/A2, each 30000 updates; results/correlation-four-arm.json
decision_rule: Before opening new test metrics: advance as a single-scene quality candidate only if all three test means improve over the best corresponding L1 bookend mean. Keep every per-view comparison. This is not multi-scene acceptance.
gsplat_integration: After native evaluation, convert the final Gaussian tensors without changing values and run the unchanged project evaluator. Report both renderers; require the same three-mean rule for deployment through gsplat. No retraining or selecting the better renderer after evaluation.
comparison_scope: Complete method engineering comparison. Renderer, optimizer, schedules and depth model differ; no isolated component attribution or paper reproduction claim.

pixel_origin_correction.reason: Detected actual raster pixel-origin mismatch; first run terminated and retained without evaluation; corrected run starts in a new directory with inherited budget
